job.reader_question: How much of the operation surface 18_ENDPOINT_INDEX.md describes actually exists?
job.title: V2 broker operations — built vs. documented, by namespace
job.subtitle: 38 of 77 documented operations are dispatched today (crates/brokerd/src/ops.rs)
job.text_summary: 38 broker operations are dispatched today against 77 named in the index (built + planned; removed rows excluded) — the built surface is roughly half the documented one. The gap is not spread thinly: seven namespaces — merge, agent, field, llm, keystore, notes, util — have zero built operations, together accounting for 26 of the 39 planned operations, two-thirds of all undispatched work. entry (8 built / 7 planned) and vault (12 built / 1 planned) carry the largest raw counts and are both mostly built; node (5 built / 3 planned, corrected 2026-08-23 from a table row that had understated it) is the only mid-size namespace with any built operations at all. Counts are re-derived directly from crates/brokerd/src/ops.rs's dispatch arms and 18_ENDPOINT_INDEX.md §1's mapping tables, not hand-entered — a table row can drift from the broker (as node's did) but this figure cannot, because it is generated from the same source ops.rs is.
